task.title: To Add Objects to your App

step.cmd: From the upper right-hand corner of the screen, click on Add Objects.
Double-click on an Object or highlight and Object and use the arrow button to add Objects to your app. To refine the list of Available values, click on Search.
Click Save to add the selected Objects to your app. The Data Migration Dashboard updates with an entry for each Object you added.

note.p: Do not worry about the sequence of Objects in your app at this time. Sequence will adjust depending on how External ID and Lookups are set.
